edit.description: kind and parent in the core, priority out, and the rendered schema block
byQueueOrder loses the rank, and only work is picked
the two new fields, the refusals, and the rendered-schema agreement pin
the queue-order and mid-wave-refill cases, and the fixtures

summary: kind (work, step, group; default work) and an optional parent replace priority in the entry core, and selection picks work alone
acceptance: the core parses kind and parent, refuses priority as an undeclared field, and a selection over a queue of all three kinds offers only its work entries, ordered on the tag
tests: an entry declaring no kind parses as work
an entry declaring a kind the core does not name is refused
an entry carrying a priority is refused as an undeclared field
a group entry is never picked
a step entry is never picked
a parent that is not a tag the grammar admits is refused
pins: parsePendingQueue accepts an entry carrying every field the rendered schema names
notes: The queue on disk still carries `priority`, so the first tick on the new code refuses every phase but the queue's own writer and a plan slice repairs it (`spec/pending.md`, *Queue reads are strict*). Tag-only order is the transient until the computed order lands; the worktrees cite change is this entry's mid-wave refill case.
